title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title \- Business Analyst \- Analyst \- ACS Song**

**Management Level 11\- Analyst**

**Location: Trivandrum**

**Must have skills: Requirement Analysis**

**Good to have skills: Business Process Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


You’ll capture user requirements and translate them into business and digitally enabled solutions across a range of industries.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Analyzing as\-is and design to\-be processes to define business, solution and system requirements.
* Organizing and facilitating workshops with clients to elicit and understand their requirements.
* Interacting with various (client) stakeholders to, gain a deep understanding of their needs and represent that knowledge to the rest of the team, while using analysis techniques like story mapping, process modelling and data\- and document analysis.
* Facilitating effective communication between the team and acting as a point of contact for clarifications on product backlog items
* Iteration planning, backlog refinement, creating user stories and story acceptance criteria is also part of your scope.
* Stakeholder management and being an interface between your team, the customer and the project manager.
* Identifying various solution options to satisfy our client's requirements and helping them and our teams make the right decision by carefully weighing business value and technical complexity.
* Creating and detailing user stories based on criteria set by client or your practice
* Collaborating with key external and internal project stakeholders who have a direct impact on their role and deliverables (e.g., decision\-makers, Subject Matter Experts)
* Ensuring that requirements and designs at an implementation level are aligned to one another, and managing the changes to related requirements
* Retaining requirement accuracy and consistency throughout and beyond the change during the entire requirements life cycle, and supporting the reuse of requirements in other solutions

  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* Ensuring the specifications and requirements are well\-defined and prepared for implementation
* Understanding initial product backlog/ inception documentation to be able to form a complete picture of project scope
* Understanding and contributing to the product backlog item refinement process
* Formulating and communicating issues faced on a project and seeking help from PM/DM/ lead BA.
* Relevant application knowledge of any commerce platforms like SAP Hybris, commerce tools or similar would complete your profile

**Additional Information**
